title: Mall World apartments, homes, dorms
content: Dwellings in Mall World seem to vary for me. Sometimes I am in a version of my childhood home (a 1880's Victorian IRL) but I discover new rooms or wings of the house. Undiscovered dimly lit, 70's style bedrooms with wall-to-wall low pile carpeting, chenille bed spreads, wood paneled walls, en suite pastel tiled bathrooms. Sometimes a library room with leather bound books. A frilly bedroom in the very top of a turret. Other times, I am moving into a new apartment that is either a psychedelic mix of every apartment I have ever lived in from college to present day, or some place entirely new and strange. Frequently, I have dreamed of moving into a top floor apartment in the tallest building in "downtown" Mall World and feel the building sway in the wind and have to lay flat on the floor. Other times, it is a pool-level shotgun flat with 1970's wood paneling and very shoddy doors that I worry are easy to break into. The pool is a strange shape, almost kidney. There are stairs that lead to a 2nd level patio. More apartments up there too. Then there is the college dorm. It always seems to be seems to be situated in an octagonal tower with pie shaped rooms, posters, low ceilings and painted cinder-block walls. I'll attempt to visit other floors in the dorm but the elevators move erratically in every direction. The stairs are dimly lit with sulfuric yellow lighting, and a strong smell of chlorine. What connects all of these places are secret passages in the closets that connect to Mall World directly. Sometimes its an attic staircase, sometimes its a dark and dirty tunnel, other times small doors and hatches.
